MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 19
   C. 17
   D. 23

2. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 1

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

6. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 17

8. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

10. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 29

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 50

12. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 169

14. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

15. Solve for x: x + 4 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 16
   C. 13
   D. 12

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 12

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

18. Solve for x: x + 7 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 6

19. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

20. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

21. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 24
   D. 25

22. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

23. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 24

24. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 17
